subject: Take-home: System Design prompt, timeline, and reviewer plan

Cc: hiring@talentpartners.io
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood take-home: System design prompt + timeline

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time to speak with the team last week. As discussed, please find attached the take-home prompt for the Senior Inference Engineer role. A quick summary below so it's easy to reference: 

• Deliverable: short design doc (2–4 pages) + a runnable evaluation notebook (Jupyter).
• Focus: tradeoffs for serving multi-model ensembles, batching strategy, and KV cache handling for long-context inference.
• Deadline: submit by Thu, Sep 3 11:59pm PT (48 hours). If you need an extension, let me know as soon as possible.
• Submission: upload to the Drive folder linked in the form and paste the Drive link in the submission form here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/submission-form-id

Attachments: redwood_takehome_system_design_v2.pdf (prompt) and submission_rubric.xlsx (grading rubric).

Please ping me if anything is unclear — minor clarifications are fine; we ask that you do not exceed the timebox in the rubric (6–8 hours estimated).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment stubs: redwood_takehome_system_design_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB), submission_rubric.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)
